claim: Intel posted a GAAP net loss of $3.7 billion in Q1 2026.
summary: Intel's Q1 2026 GAAP results would have been reported in late April 2026, after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04. Without tools and with no pre-cutoff knowledge establishing this figure, the claimed $3.7 billion GAAP net loss for Q1 2026 cannot be verified.
